svg.aria-label: Five-fold split over perturbation identities, with scoring done by the harness
svg.text: Perturbation identities, shuffled once with a fixed seed
Each run holds out one fold. Across five runs every perturbation is tested exactly once,
and scores are averaged per perturbation, then across folds (paper, Methods).
